rule: Definitions are fixed before inspecting v2 outcomes. Any post-result change requires a new version.

data.source: same immutable 2020-2025 archive used by CRR Flow-Ratio v1
data.universe: daily top 500 by trailing 20-day average turnover; industries require >=3 current constituents

timing: Features use information available by T close only. Outcome entry is T+1 open and exits at T+k close.
flow: foreign_net + trust_net, converted to approximate amount by same-day close; dealer excluded as in v1 primary test

definitions.share_w: For w in {1,5,20}, sum industry institutional net amount over w trading days, clip negative industry sums to zero, then divide by the sum of all positive industry sums on T.
definitions.primary_accel: share_5 - share_20. Positive means the industry's share of the market's positive institutional flow pool has expanded recently versus its 20-day state.

outcome.industry_return_k: median constituent return from T+1 open to T+k close, k in {5,10,20}
outcome.market_return_k: median return of the same daily top-500 universe

tests.primary: Rank primary_accel cross-sectionally into daily quintiles. Compare Q1..Q5 and report 5/10/20-day excess returns and Newey-West t on daily bucket means.
tests.monotonicity: Daily cross-sectional Spearman(primary_accel, industry_excess_k), averaged through time.
tests.secondary: Repeat descriptive quintile tests for secondary_1_5, secondary_1_20, secondary_ratio_5_20, secondary_ratio_1_5. Secondary tests cannot rescue the primary result.

pass_bar: Primary PASS only if development Q5 excess_20 > +1.0 percentage point with Newey-West t >= 2.0, and Q5 excess_20 is positive in both 2025 holdout and 2020 stress. No secondary metric can rescue a failed primary test.
anti_overfit: No changing 1/5/20 windows, Q5 definition, universe, institution mix, outcome horizon, or pass bar after results are visible. Q3/Q4 patterns from v1 are not used to define v2.
